title: Shark dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='water' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#7fd8ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#3aa6d6'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- fins behind body, waving like arms -->
  <path d='M28 52 Q10 30 30 40 Q36 46 36 56 Z' fill='#4f7fa8'/>
  <path d='M72 52 Q90 30 78 42 Q74 48 72 56 Z' fill='#4f7fa8'/>
  <!-- tail fin, mid wag -->
  <path d='M24 74 Q6 66 12 82 Q20 84 26 80 Z' fill='#4f7fa8'/>
  <path d='M24 74 Q10 92 22 94 Q28 86 28 80 Z' fill='#5f92bd'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='20' ry='22' fill='url(#water)'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='12' ry='10' fill='#eaf6fb'/>
  <!-- dorsal fin -->
  <path d='M46 48 L50 36 L56 48 Z' fill='#67a8d1'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <path d='M50 34 Q28 36 30 54 Q40 58 50 56 Q60 58 70 54 Q72 36 50 34 Z' fill='url(#water)'/>
  <!-- mouth smile -->
  <path d='M36 52 Q50 60 64 52' stroke='#1f6d94' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- teeth -->
  <path d='M40 54 l3 4 l3 -4 Z' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <path d='M48 55 l3 4 l3 -4 Z' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <path d='M56 54 l3 4 l3 -4 Z' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='44' r='4' fill='#0f3f5a'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='44' r='4' fill='#0f3f5a'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='43' r='1.4' fill='#bff0ff'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='43' r='1.4' fill='#bff0ff'/>
  <!-- gills -->
  <path d='M38 48 q-2 4 0 8' stroke='#1f6d94' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M62 48 q2 4 0 8' stroke='#1f6d94' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- dancing legs -->
  <path d='M40 88 Q32 96 40 98' stroke='#4f7fa8' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M60 88 Q68 96 60 98' stroke='#4f7fa8' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- music notes -->
  <circle cx='84' cy='30' r='4' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <path d='M88 30 v-12' stroke='#ffd166' stroke-width='2'/>
  <path d='M88 18 q6 0 6 5' stroke='#ffd166' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <circle cx='16' cy='24' r='3.5' fill='#ff9ecb'/>
  <path d='M19.5 24 v-10' stroke='#ff9ecb' stroke-width='2'/>
  <path d='M19.5 14 q5 0 5 4' stroke='#ff9ecb' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
</svg>
